messages:
talia: Quick heads-up  VerdantHealth private deploy cutover is 09:00 PDT tomorrow. Staging hit 3 issues: KMS key rotation failure, healthcheck timeouts from our probes, and their security team asked for longer audit retention. This is a potential renewal-risk unless we close gaps.

james: Network summary: their transit gateway route for 10.20.0.0/16 isn't propagating to the peering attachment. Healthchecks show RSTs from their firewall. I'll drop a minimal cloud-fw & route table snippet to share.

james: FW snippet for cloud console (replace with customer CIDR & our probe IPs):
```
Inbound: Protocol TCP, Source 54.32.21.10/32, Port 8080, Description: redwood healthcheck
Route table: target: tg-attach-xxxx, Destination: 10.20.0.0/16
```

priya: Security notes: KMS rotation failed because their key policy blocks kms:GenerateDataKey for cross-account roles during rotation. We need a staged rotation: create new key, update alias, re-encrypt small set, then rotate. Also require audit logs retained >= 90 days (they asked 180d as preferred). Ask them for the KMS key ARN + account id for trust policy.

priya: Minimal trust policy to allow our runtime to use the key (provide their account-id and replace ROLE_ARN):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/role_redwood_runtime"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```

micah: Commercial/AM: If they want 180d retention that may change pricing. I'll prepare a short note for billing. For renewal-risk scoring: currently medium. If infra + security steps are confirmed pre-cutover we'll drop to low.

infra-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/priv-deploys/cutover-checklist  includes preflight, smoke tests, rollback actions. Support ticket created: CS-85577.

talia: Owner/actions & ETAs:
- james: send fw + route snippet to customer by 16:00 PT today
- priya: validate staged rotation steps & sample re-encrypt test by 22:00 PT
- micah: pricing note for 180d retention and AM outreach by EOD
- infra-bot: ticket CS-85577 will be updated with logs and rollback playbook

james: I'll also include a curl-based healthcheck test they can run from their VPC to validate path:
```
curl -v http://10.20.5.10:8080/health -H "Host: redwood-probe" --connect-timeout 5
```

talia: I'll message Verdant with the snippets and ask for KMS ARN + account id immediately. Please update this thread when your step is done. :thumbsup:

micah: Flag for AMs: if they push for 180d retention as default, we may need a contract amendment.

priya: One more security ask: request S3 presigned upload of their audit artifacts or use our secure upload link. No attachments over email.

james: noted. will update when snippet sent.

priya: If staged rotation test passes in staging within 12h we should be safe to proceed with cutover; otherwise plan rollback window.

talia: Summary: short-term medium risk -> low if steps complete within 24-48h. Tagging @james @priya @micah  please close out your actions and update CS-85577.
